title: Mount CFB verified selector identity router in production API
scope: Single-owner repair from production V5 run 36491623964. The live Game Total selector rendered verified matchups as disabled with 'ESPN ID unavailable'. The selector page already calls /api/v1/cfb/selector/verified-games, and sports_api/api/cfb_odds_v1.py already implements that strict official-identity endpoint, but sports_api/main.py did not mount cfb_odds_router. Mount only that existing router and lock the production contract in the V5 self-test.
acceptance: sports_api/main.py imports and includes only the existing cfb_odds_router needed by the selector identity contract.
/api/v1/cfb/selector/verified-games remains official-ID-only, synthetic_ids=false, projection_weight=0.0, and fail closed.
No CFB selector UI, matchup selection logic, projection math, sportsbook influence, router UI, NFL Rushing, Receiving, Passing, roster, availability, probability, stake, or wager logic changes.
V5 regression proves the production API mounts the implemented selector identity endpoint.

evidence.failure: V163 initial selected game identity was not exposed on the app frame
evidence.failure_screenshot_observation: GAMES ON THIS DAY cards rendered as disabled and displayed ESPN ID unavailable
